Research construction and domain audit, 31 October 2026
Authoring branch: fast_charge_instrument; root owns synthesis.

STATUS

This replaces the deliberately conservative reset--Ramsey--escape charge
meter with one maintained tunnel-contact exposure. It also identifies a
record-sensitive contraction that the root construction can use to suppress
OFF hopping. The probabilistic and instrument statements below are proved
on their admitted detector model. Ordinary Coulomb coupling and lead
tunnelling generate that model; a finite-bandwidth continuum qualification
is stated separately, not silently supplied by the theorem.

No superiority over equally informed conventional QPC, rf-SET, or resonator
readout is claimed. The advance is a guarantee that survives unprepared,
noncommutatively evolving retained source degrees of freedom, and an
explicit relation between usable record information and suppression of
coherence between charge sectors. Established fast sensors are components
to use, not weak alternatives to defeat.

Status: proved estimates for the explicitly stated continuous instrument and
finite-carrier Hamiltonian models. These are not a demonstrated material/device
window. All earlier results and their counterexamples are retained. No claim of
priority is made for continuous charge sensing, quantum Zeno suppression, or
singlet-triplet computation.

1. The physical question

How much residual charge hopping can a real measurement tolerate, when its
source is a quantum system that is neither prepared nor estimated? The relevant
answer involves the information in the retained detector record, not just the
unconditional dephasing rate. This distinction matters when the full emitted
history is part of the output of the operation.

The old pulsed Hubbard construction remains a valid construction. It used a
linear bound on OFF hopping over the whole sensing time. A maintained charge
detector provides a better isolation mechanism: a coherent boundary correction
of order h_off/Gamma and an accumulated correction of order h_off^2 T/Gamma.
The boundary term is real and must not be erased by calling the effect Zeno.

There is also an exact discrete version, based on fresh carriers and a finite
tunnel contact. It needs no Markov approximation for the detector reservoir.
The fresh carrier state, timed contact, collection and output measurement are
maintained resources, explicitly distinguished from the unprepared source.

2. Definitions, outputs, and norm

Let P_q, q=1,...,d, be charge projectors. A block may itself contain a source E,
all live reference/data systems, and all classical records accumulated so far.
Nothing is put into E merely to hide its computational disturbance. The norm

  ||X||_box = sum_{p,q} ||P_p X P_q||_1

includes integration/summation over retained classical records. Every estimate
below holds after tensoring an arbitrary reference. For a positive normalized
state, x=P X=sum_q P_q X P_q has ||x||_box=1. Its off-diagonal part y has

(sum_q sqrt(tr X_qq))^2 <= d. This statement holds pointwise in a classical
record, and integration gives the same bound.

Astra continuation, 2026-10-31

MAIN CHOICE

The strongest opening developed here is a way to qualify operations against a
large, disordered quantum source without bounding its entire many-body energy
band. The quantity that matters for finite-time energy isolation is the
source's ability to CHANGE THE COUPLING, measured by a local commutator. An
explicit cycle uses fresh lower-state orbital carriers to remove energy from
spin-selective charge transfer. It replaces repeated complete charge tests by
unobserved, spin-blind energy-removal contacts and two final charge tests.

The general isolation estimate and the finite-contact cycle are proved below.
The Coulomb matrix element and all accompanying projected terms are derived in
the companion physical-contact note. A screened source supplies a concrete
large-source domain. These results are not a demonstrated semiconductor device
window, a new universal-computation theorem, or a fault-tolerance threshold.
Repeated-interaction cooling, capacitive quantum-dot control, and spin blockade
are established mechanisms. The contribution is their source-uniform complete
operation and the admission criterion, with the actual resources exposed.

1. Why a whole-source bandwidth is the wrong default

A bare orbital or charge gap is insufficient: a source transition can resonantly
bridge it. The earlier split-manifold and orbital counterexamples remain valid.
But the sufficient condition 'gap exceeds the ENTIRE source spectrum' is often
far too strong. A source of N local cells has an extensive spectrum even when a
particular local operator can transfer only a small amount of energy efficiently.

There are two complementary formulations. The first is an exact finite-time
unitary estimate; it does not use a master equation, a secular approximation,
an initial source state, or any minimum source level spacing. The second is a
spectral sum rule useful for passive reservoirs. The first is the operative
admission proof for the cold-carrier construction here.
